import numpy as np

    rects1 = ax.bar(x - width/2, april, width, label='April', color='#4F81BD')

    ax.set_xlabel('Operator')
    ax.set_ylabel('Value')
    ax.set_title('Operator Statistics for April and May')
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(operators)
    ax.legend()
    for rect in rects1 + rects2:
        height = rect.get_height()
        ax.annotate('{}'.format(height),
                    xy=(rect.get_x() + rect.get_width() / 2, height),
                    xytext=(0, 3),
                    textcoords='offset points',
                    ha='center', va='bottom')
    return fig
